title: 广场边的蓝木门  (The Blue Door)

segments.t: Ten minutes later, Qing has crossed the stone bridge in Chengdu, yet two small lanes branch off behind the pharmacy. She phones Chen from beside a stone fountain. Listen first.
老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
太好了！卷帘门开了吗？
老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等一秒。
一定看准里面铜圈是二十毫米宽。
他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
快点——我刚听到二楼楼梯有脚步声！
Now let's go through the call, line by line.
老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
'Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!' Phone check-in
听得见
inserts 'able' between 'listen' and 'perceive' to ask 'can you hear me?'.
走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
'Take the second lane beside the flower stall; do not enter the narrow alley.' Putting
第二
before 'lane' turns cardinal 'two' into ordinal 'second'—a rule that works for every number.
正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
'Walking forward now... oh, I see the golden key sign and the blue wooden door!' Spotting something with your eyes uses
看见
pairing 'look' with 'perceive' just like 'listen-perceive' earlier.
老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等一秒。
'The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.' Don't hang up:
别挂电话
literally says 'don't hang the telephone', recalling wall-mounted receivers.
他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
'He matched it against the old valve—he has two left on the shelf!' Lucky timing word:
正好
literally 'just-right good', captures happy coincidences like two valves sitting on the shelf.
两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
'Buy both! Keeping a spare saves worry next winter too.' Everyday peace-of-mind compound:
省心
literally 'save heart-effort', means 'worry-free' or 'saves trouble'.
付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
'Paid in cash! Open your toolbox and wait—I am running back across the bridge!' Paying with bills and coins uses
付了现金
where 'present-gold' is Mandarin's word for cash.
快点——我刚听到二楼楼梯有脚步声！
'Hurry—I just heard footsteps on the second-floor stairs!' Quick urge to speed up:
快点
adds 'a bit' onto 'fast'—'a little faster!' or 'hurry up!'. Now let's hear the whole scene again without stopping.
老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
听得很清楚。你站在小石头喷泉旁边吗？
对！左边有两条小路——我走哪一条？
走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
正往前走……啊，看见金钥匙招牌和蓝木门了！
太好了！卷帘门开了吗？
老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等一秒。
一定看准里面铜圈是二十毫米宽。
他拿旧阀门比对了——架子上正好还剩两个！
两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
付了现金！打开工具箱等我，我往桥那边跑回来了！
快点——我刚听到二楼楼梯有脚步声！
Two new brass valves in her pocket and early risers already stirring on the stairs. Next time, Mei and Manager Zhou stall for time at breakfast. See you next time.
回头见！
